selection.anchor_ranking: Layer-18 local appearance descending, then final-layer target-memory score, objectness and deterministic box/index ties.
selection.completion: If the top local anchor is tiled, take the highest-ranked full-frame proposal from the same winning reference only when it contains at least 80 percent of the anchor and retains at least 99 percent of its local score; otherwise retain the anchor.

literature_motivation.use: Intermediate DINOv2 features preserve local part appearance under viewpoint change.
Reliable local evidence can vote for a larger object extent.

claim_boundary: A pass is narrow same-provider new-family confirmation of an exact-instance localization component. It is not source-independent generalization, raw-phone operation, named entrance or portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability or safety evidence.
